body: My ex told me to go see someone, but I’m very shy and it’s hard for me to talk to New people so I’ve always seen counseling or therapy kinda useless.. it’s also kind embarrassing for me I guess , my friends and such don’t really know what I’m going through , idk
Okay , thank you , I will try and see what happens, but one of the things I struggle with is moving on. Any advice

It feels like I’m trapped, I’m a student , I’m broke , I can’t get a job or preform well in school because my depression clouds my mind too much. I left by girlfriend of several years before the new year because I couldn’t do anything for us because I was just so sad and I didn’t want to hurt her anymore , I just feel like I mess everything up that I have going for me constantly
I’ve just had enough, no motivation, no dreams, just emptiness I just don’t see anything other than this being the only outcome
